headline: Between the clock and the street.
body: The tea has gone cold. A dog barks once, two streets over, and stops. The lamp on the desk remains unlit.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: clear, thin stars above the roofs

pulses.label: Light
pulses.value: streetlamps, one warm square three floors up

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: empty, wet patches catching the lamps
